headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after Chinese spy affair scandal and lawsuits
summary: Nvidia investigated CEO Jensen Huang after reports he had an affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence operative, which he admitted in a staff memo. A second affair allegation followed, shareholders sued as the stock slid, and lawmakers summoned Huang over espionage concerns. The board moved to oust him; he resigned, CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO, and Trump proposed Tim Cook as a successor.
